key_insight: Pairing LLM-based interpretation with deterministic exact cover solving improves Zebra-puzzle reasoning beyond purely neural approaches.
engineering_relevance: The framework separates natural-language parsing from symbolic solving, enabling reliable reasoning when the generated formal encoding is correct.
method: An LLM translates puzzle entities and constraints into structured tool calls.
The tool calls construct an exact cover instance for a symbolic solver.
Solver feedback guides iterative repairs of invalid or under- or overconstrained encodings, using expected solution uniqueness.
evidence_signal: Across multiple model scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families, the abstract reports consistent gains over strong neural baselines, including CoT, and recent neuro-symbolic methods.
watch_item: Solver guarantees apply to the encoded problem; a unique solution alone does not establish faithful translation of the original clues.
paper_title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
